payload.reason: The evidence provides specific modifications made to post-trained BERT, including the application of adversarial training and adjustments in training epochs and dropout values.

claims.text: Post-trained BERT has been modified by applying adversarial training to improve its performance in Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis (ABSA).
The model is initialized with post-trained BERT and undergoes an ablation study to determine optimal training epochs and dropout values, enhancing its performance.
The modifications resulted in significant performance improvements in tasks such as aspect extraction and aspect sentiment classification compared to the original post-trained BERT.
